title: Thieves have found a way to empty Wal-Mart gift cards
description: Wal-Mart says it is investigating a possible breach in the system that allowed thieves to steal the value from gift cards, leaving customers with worthless plastic.

textual.context: Presented as news reporting about a possible system breach and affected customers; the supplied records do not establish the mechanism independently.
textual.potential_relevance: The reported relationship between purchasing a gift card and its value later being removed or redeemed elsewhere is a concretely described mechanism that may require later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish who accessed or redeemed the card, how access occurred, the number of affected cards, or whether the reported breach was confirmed.

visual.observation: A TV news segment shows the headline "GIFT CARD THEFT" alongside a Walmart storefront image, and an interview lower-third identifies the topic as "WALMART GIFT CARD HIJACKED."
visual.context: Visible news-reporting context from ABC Action News with "TAKING ACTION FOR YOU" banners; the wording appears as a reported issue, not as an offer or promotion.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship is a gift-card value/access issue explicitly described as theft or hijacking and linked to Walmart gift cards in a warning/reporting context.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show the described method, any perpetrator, a transaction record, a card number, a website, or any requested viewer action.

textual_context_notes.observation: The report attributes the issue to an investigation and says information was shared with law enforcement.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as an ABC Action News consumer report about alleged Walmart gift card value theft. The reporter framing, news graphics, interviews, store coverage, and reference to information being shared with law enforcement support a warning or reporting context rather than a solicitation for money, cards, or services.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an anti-scam warning and investigation concerning reported gift-card theft, including a possible breach, an affected customer account, and information shared with law enforcement.
